build_crowdhuman_dataset: build a CrowdHumanDataset instance to load person detection annotations from CrowdHuman dataset files
load_data_list: load all CrowdHuman annotations from the annotation file into a list of parsed data dictionaries
parse_data_info: parse a raw CrowdHuman annotation dict into structured data with image path, dimensions, and instance bounding boxes
review_CrowdHumanDataset_init: review the CrowdHumanDataset constructor to understand how extra annotation files and image metadata are initialized
refactor_parse_data_info: refactor parse_data_info to support additional bounding box types beyond fbox, hbox, and vbox
